verdict.rationale: Missive documents built-in AI that composes and replies to messages, and its assistant creates drafts that resolve the user's name and email, so drafting a reply for review is supported. Nothing shows the AI learning or matching the user's own voice and tone; the only personalization documented is name and email variables. Missing for 10: voice/tone matching or style learning from past emails, any evidence that drafts avoid generic boilerplate, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.

Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile, exactly like the composer does.
Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies without leaving the chat
